title: fix(types,plugin-form,fields): the record form draws a field's inlineHelpText under its control, and help leaves BaseFieldMetadata (objectui#12213)
body:
Part of #12213

Clause-②: yes

The record form now draws a field's `inlineHelpText` under its control. `BaseFieldMetadata` declares `inlineHelpText` by reference to the spec and no longer declares `help`. The four field docs pages teach `inlineHelpText`. The served `help` READ leg is kept: the dispatch's D1 stop condition fired, so that leg is reported below for a ruling and not deleted.

## What changed

- **One read for the two form builders.** `fieldHelpText(field)` is new in `sectionFields` (package-internal, not exported from the package index). `ObjectForm`'s own field builder and `fromObjectSchema` both call it. The flat, sectioned and tabbed forms reach those two builders. Order, first non-empty value wins:
  - FROM `field.help || field.description` → TO `field.inlineHelpText || field.help || field.description`
- **Action params.** `resolveActionParam` (`@object-ui/fields`) reads the same order for a field-backed param's `helpText`. `@object-ui/fields` cannot import `@object-ui/plugin-form`, so the order is written out again there, with a comment pointing back to `fieldHelpText`.
  - FROM `param.helpText ?? field.help ?? field.description` → TO `param.helpText ?? (field.inlineHelpText || field.help || field.description)`
- **Types.** In `BaseFieldMetadata` (`@object-ui/types`):
  - FROM `help?: string` → TO `inlineHelpText?: Field['inlineHelpText']`, with `Field` from `@objectstack/spec/data`.
  - Every field metadata type extends this interface, so none of them declares `help` now.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/fields/` `auto-number`, `file`, `object` and `text` write `inlineHelpText:` in place of `help:`.
- **Changesets.** `@object-ui/types` minor: the removal of `help` is a break, stated in the changeset. `@object-ui/plugin-form` patch. `@object-ui/fields` patch. Each one gives FROM → TO.

**Route vs the suggested route.** The helper is in `sectionFields.ts` because the claim's file list has that file. Putting one read in `@object-ui/fields`, so the resolver could share it too, would have needed a new module plus an export from `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`. Neither is on the claim's list, and the claim says to stop on a breach. So the order is written in two places: the plugin-form helper and the resolver.

## Mechanism measurements (dispatch zone 2)

- **D1, the fold.** Confirmed: the fold does not stamp `help`. Measured by running `normalizeSchemaReferenceKeys` (`@object-ui/core`) on `{ help: 'H' }`:
  - The alias probe of `help` is `help`, and no key `FieldSchema` declares maps to it. `inlineHelpText` probes to `inlinehelptext`.
  - The def comes out unchanged (`help` stays, and no `inlineHelpText` is added). The dev-mode `no-declared-twin` warning fires.
  - Control: in the same run, `display_field` folded onto `displayField`.
  - On spec 17.7.0, `FieldSchema.safeParse` gives `unrecognized_keys ['help']` for a `help` field and accepts the same field with `inlineHelpText`. So no document that passes the write door carries `help`.
- **D1, the served path. ⇒ The stop condition fired.**
  - An objectstack server whose `@objectstack/spec` is older than 17.7.0 serves `help` on any field its translation bundle has a help entry for.
  - The translator wrote the bundle's `objects.OBJECT.fields.FIELD.help` entry onto the served field's `help` key. That entry is the translated `description`.
  - Evidence: the published 17.6.0 tarball's `dist/system/index.mjs` has `next.help = translatedHelp` once (control: `next.label = translatedLabel` also once). The installed 17.7.0 has `next.help =` zero times and `next.description = translatedDescription` once.
  - The change is objectstack `bab76850c`. 17.7.0 was published 2026-10-06 and 17.6.0 on 2026-10-02.
  - Nothing in objectui folds that key. So `help` is not deleted from the read. It is kept as the second step of `fieldHelpText` and the resolver, typed on a local hand-off interface (`FieldHelpTextSource`, and `RuntimeField` in the resolver), and not on the authoring face. Options are below.
- **D2.** Confirmed, and the leg was handled as the PM guessed: `inlineHelpText` goes in front and `help` stays (see D1).
  - Before (at the base, reverse verification below): the action-param dialog's help line for a field with `inlineHelpText` showed its `description`.
  - After: it shows `inlineHelpText`. Pinned in `ActionParamDialog.fieldHelpLine-12213.test.tsx`, which resolves a real param and renders the real dialog.
- **D3.** Confirmed from its type. `FlowNodeConfigField`'s `field` is a `FlowConfigField` (from `flow-node-config`), which has `id`, `path`, `kind`, `label` and `help`. It describes an inspector config field. It is not field metadata, so it is not touched.
- **D4, placement.** Same place.
  - The form renderer draws `FormField.description` in `FormDescription` right after `FormControl`, inside the field row. `FormControl` names that element in the control's `aria-describedby`.
  - Flow screens draw `inlineHelpText` in a `p` under the control, tied by `aria-describedby`.
  - Pinned by role on the flat, sectioned and tabbed forms: the control's accessible description is the help text, and the element comes after the control in document order.
  - One difference, not restyled: the form's line is `text-sm`, while the flow screen's is `text-xs`.
- **D5.** Kept. The flat builder still appends the size hint to the `description` it built. A file field with `inlineHelpText: 'PDF only'` and `maxSize` shows `PDF only (Max size: 10.0 MB)`, pinned. `objectFormFileSizeHint-12156.test.tsx` passes without changes.
- **D6.** Picked `||`. An empty string reads as absent, so `inlineHelpText: ''` falls back to `description`. Two reasons:
  - The spec declares no setting that hides the help line. With `??`, an empty string would become an undeclared way to suppress the description.
  - Studio's inspector already stores a cleared box as no key (`inlineHelpText: v || undefined`).
  - Pinned on all three form layouts and in the dialog.
- **D7.** No hits. A search of `skills/**` (27 files on `origin/main`) for a `help` key found 0, and for `inlineHelpText` found 0. Control: the same search for a `description` key found 7.

## The `help` leg: kept, for a ruling

- **A. Retire it now.** Delete one step in `fieldHelpText`, one in the resolver, and the two local `help` members.
  - Cost: when a host runs against a server on spec 17.6.x or older, record forms show the source-language `description` in place of the translated text, in non-English sessions. In English the two strings are the same, because the bundle entry is extracted from `description`.
  - The changeset would state that floor.
- **B. Keep it until a named server floor.** For example, until objectui requires a 17.7+ server. This PR does B for now.
  - Cost: a second spelling in the reader. AGENTS.md #0.1 discourages that.
  - Per the four-axis framework, a staged step needs named external-user evidence, and I have none.
- **C. Fold `help` onto `description` at ingestion.** Not workable: `description` is already set on the same def, and the fold never overwrites a value.

Recommendation: **A**, with the break stated in the changeset. The spec door refuses `help`. The producer (an older server's translator) is fixed upstream and published. Any 17.x server can be upgraded within the major. The PM rules. This round followed the dispatch's stop condition and did not delete the leg.

**The seat's disposition:** the leg is put to the ruler on objectui#12213, comment `6123212511`. This PR lands with `Part of`, so that card stays open as the decision's anchor. Its question is a follow-up deletion, which this PR neither makes nor rules out.

## Tests (all runs at HEAD `629e77d`)

- New: `objectFormInlineHelpText-12213.test.tsx` (plugin-form, 16 cases), `ActionParamDialog.fieldHelpLine-12213.test.tsx` (app-shell, 6 cases), `field-metadata-inline-help-text-12213.test.ts` (types, 2 runtime cases plus type-level pins).
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/`: 179 files passed, 2200 tests passed, 1 skipped.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/ packages/fields/ packages/core/src/utils/`: 723 files passed (1 skipped), 16105 tests passed, 7 skipped.
- The 80 app-shell test files that name `resolveActionParams` or `ActionParamDialog`, plus 3 plugin-grid files that name `resolveActionParam` or `helpText`: 83 files passed, 816 tests passed. This is a declared narrowing to the resolver and dialog consumers.
- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/`: 180 files passed (2 skipped), 5490 tests passed.
- `type-check` (the script name echoed each time), after the dependency-closure build: `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/app-shell` all exit 0.

## Reverse verification (from committed state, restored with `git checkout HEAD`, hash-checked)

- **Readers back to the base** (`ObjectForm.tsx`, `sectionFields.ts`, `resolveActionParams.ts` checked out from `6c437b0`). Marker counts proved the mutation was on disk: `fieldHelpText` in `sectionFields` went 5 → 0, and `field.inlineHelpText` in the resolver went 1 → 0.
  - Result: 8 failed, 14 passed. The failures were the `inlineHelpText` case on each of the 3 layouts, the served-help-loses-to-`inlineHelpText` case on each layout, the size-hint case, and the dialog `inlineHelpText` case.
  - The cases that stayed green are the ones that must hold on the base too: the description fallback, the empty-string fallback, the served `help` leg, and the no-help control.
  - After restore, `git diff HEAD` was empty and the three blob hashes matched `HEAD`.
- **`help?: string` put back on `BaseFieldMetadata`.** `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` in types exited 2 with exactly 4 errors, all in the new pin: the two `help`-absence assertions (TS2344) and the two `@ts-expect-error` lines on `help` literals (TS2578). After restore, the hash matched.
- **`help:` put back in `content/docs/fields/text.mdx`.** `pnpm check:doc-snippets` exited 1: `TS2353 ... 'help' does not exist in type 'TextFieldMetadata'` in that page, 789 of 789 blocks judged, 1 failed. After restore, the hash matched.

## Gates (local)

- Exit 0: `check:doc-snippets` (789 of 789 blocks, 0 failed, after the gate's scoped build), `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-json`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:readme-exports` (after the same build), `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:control-bytes`, `check-changeset-presence` (7 source files of 4 released packages, 3 changesets), `check-changeset-no-major`, `changeset:check`, `check:changeset-claims`.
- Exit 0, derived from the diff (new tests, docs, changesets): `check:test-path-roots`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:unreferenced-sources`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 14 changed paths answered NOT GOVERNED.
- Lint, narrowed: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 7 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files gave 7 files, 0 errors, and 70 warnings. The warnings are `no-explicit-any` and hook warnings: 67 already in the touched files, plus 3 `as any` schema casts in the new plugin-form test, the same pattern the size-hint test uses.
  - Why this narrowing excludes nothing: `eslint.config.js` covers `**/*.{ts,tsx}`, and its config sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService` (type-aware linting is off). The local rules in `eslint-rules/` read no other file. So this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it does not touch.

## Patch round 1

`bfc920f` corrects one published JSDoc phrase that round 0 made false. `BaseFieldMetadata.inlineHelpText` said its shared read lives in `@object-ui/fields`; it names `@object-ui/plugin-form` now. That is one line in `packages/types/src/field-types.ts`. The contract review `6123580193` found it. Gates on `bfc920f`, exit 0 each: `@object-ui/types` `type-check`, the `field-metadata-inline-help-text-12213` pin, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes` and `check-changeset-presence`.

## Acceptance notes (not changed here)

- Studio's object form canvas (`ObjectFormCanvas`) draws a field's `description` above the field stub and never draws `inlineHelpText`. A field that has both now shows different text on the canvas and on the record form. This is from reading the code only; it was not reproduced in a browser. Carrier: none. Noted, not filed: a code reading with no measured wrong result at a public door.
- `buildDefaultPageSchema` (plugin-detail) has a comment saying the spec's `ObjectFieldLike` reads `help`. Since spec 17.7.0, that duck type has no `help` member.
- The size hint is appended only by `ObjectForm`'s own builder. Forms that resolve through `fromObjectSchema` (tabbed, drawer, modal, wizard, split) show no size hint. This was already so before this change.
- The same docs literals carry other keys the spec door refuses, measured with `FieldSchema.safeParse` on 17.7.0: `pattern` and `pattern_message` on `text`, `starting_number` on the auto-number page, and `schema` on `object`. `auto_number` and `object` are also not `type` values in the spec. The seat filed this family as objectui#12242, the close-out card covering every exported field metadata member against `FieldSchema`.
